docs(arc42): complete the architecture of the tooling for agentic app creation

## Intent

With goals and archetypes settled, complete the architecture so it can be reviewed as a whole. Failed pre-push runs should stay below 5 at the 90th percentile.

## Key changes

- Chapters 2 to 9, 11 and 12: constraints, context, solution strategy, building blocks, runtime scenarios, deployment, concepts (rule model, promotion path, plan file, messages for agents, validation report), 21 decisions, risks and glossary.
- Chapter 1 shows the five-step journey of a creator: clarify, set up, build, validate, list.
- The scenario for failed pre-push runs uses p90 below 5.
